description: Dates and numbers as the Translations Editor shows them, in UTC with the en-US default locale: Date construction (clock, ISO strings, copies), getters and setters across midnight, toString/toISOString/toUTCString/toDateString, toLocale*String with a runtime locale (en-US, de-DE, fr-FR, en-GB), Intl.DateTimeFormat and Intl.NumberFormat constants, Number.prototype.toLocaleString with percent options, Date.parse of typed text (valid and invalid), sorting with an Intl.Collator comparator and localeCompare, and a one-second interval advanced by virtual time
